# NEWSROOM


## UTStarcom at CIOE 2026: AI DC Networking Focus


In a booth tour interview at the CIOE 2026 exhibition, UTStarcom CTO Dr. Lingrong Lu outlined the company’s transition toward AI cluster architectures, showcasing its new OCS concept prototypes. She emphasized how scaling AI workloads beyond copper limits necessitates complementary OCS and EPS deployment, underscoring UTStarcom’s optical networking expertise and its commitment to advancing Silicon Photonics as a critical technology for AI DC networking evolution.
